item.title: April bank holiday banks To Remain Closed For 15 Days In April 2021
item.description: April bank holiday Alert: according to the notice from the RBI, the private and public area banks the nation over will stay shut for 15 days including second, fourth Saturdays and Sundays in April 2021. Out of all these bank occasions, eight occasions are because of different celebrations. Besides, the banks will be closed on April 1 because of the end of records while the rest are standard occasions including four Sundays and two Saturdays. Aside from this, the banks are shut from March 27 to April 4, besides on 2 days because of the fourth Saturday and Holi. The banks on April 2 in the nation will be shut because of Good Friday and again on April 4, which is a Sunday.
